record.chaining: the substrate for the WebSocket forks; on its own it composes only with a peer that accepts UDP.
record.binding_note: it creates a TUN interface and speaks UDP; a UDP block stops it, so it adds no egress path
record.reliability_note: upstream mirror lags git.zx2c4.com; the Linux kernel module is the faster path where it exists
record.confidence_note: the verdict concerns egress only; this is the implementation every WebSocket fork starts from

evidence.proved: "This is an implementation of WireGuard in Go" and the wireguard-go wg0 / wg(8) usage
"Mirror only. Official repository is at https://git.zx2c4.com/wireguard-go"; 4465 stars; last push 2026-10-06; no GitHub releases
on Linux the README says to use the kernel module instead, "which is faster and better integrated into the OS"

record.notes: Userspace implementation of WireGuard in Go. Serves as a standard WireGuard network interface on platforms without native kernel support. Standard implementation uses UDP transport.

extras.wg_detail: "With wireguard-go, instead simply run: wireguard-go wg0 ... When an interface is running, you may use wg(8) to configure it", so the standard configuration applies unchanged

extras.transit_note: carries the tunnel over UDP to the configured endpoint
